notes: Attributive article on בְּנוּיָה takes the relative 'that' under rule 41; the participle keeps 'art builded' with its construction-supplied copula.

Reflexive dative לָהּ has no English of its own: the ASV's 'compact together' spends 'together' on יַחְדָּו, so both the preposition and its suffix are unrepresented under rule 40's closing sentences.
